input.command:
cat > /tmp/analysis.py <<'EOF'
import duckdb
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

con = duckdb.connect()
df = con.sql("""
    SELECT YEAR(crash_date) AS year,
           SUM(number_of_pedestrians_killed) AS pedestrians_killed
    FROM './data/crashes.parquet'
    WHERE crash_date >= '2013-01-01' AND crash_date < '2026-01-01'
      AND number_of_pedestrians_killed IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1
    ORDER BY 1
""").df()
df["year"] = df["year"].astype(int)
df["pedestrians_killed"] = df["pedestrians_killed"].astype(int)
df.to_csv("./out/values.csv", index=False)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))
bars = ax.bar(df["year"], df["pedestrians_killed"], color="#1f77b4", width=0.7)
ax.bar_label(bars, padding=3, fontsize=9)
ax.set_title("Pedestrians Killed in NYC Motor Vehicle Crashes by Year (2013-2025)")
ax.set_xlabel("Year")
ax.set_ylabel("Pedestrians killed")
ax.set_xticks(df["year"])
ax.set_ylim(0, max(df["pedestrians_killed"]) * 1.15)
ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.3)
ax.set_axisbelow(True)
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig("./out/initial.png", dpi=150)
print(df.to_string(index=False))
print("2013:", int(df.loc[df.year == 2013, "pedestrians_killed"].iloc[0]),
      "2019:", int(df.loc[df.year == 2019, "pedestrians_killed"].iloc[0]),
      "2020:", int(df.loc[df.year == 2020, "pedestrians_killed"].iloc[0]),
      "2025:", int(df.loc[df.year == 2025, "pedestrians_killed"].iloc[0]))
print("min year:", int(df.loc[df.pedestrians_killed.idxmin(), "year"]), int(df.pedestrians_killed.min()))
print("max year:", int(df.loc[df.pedestrians_killed.idxmax(), "year"]), int(df.pedestrians_killed.max()))
print("total:", int(df.pedestrians_killed.sum()), "mean:", round(df.pedestrians_killed.mean(), 1))
print("chg 2013->2025:", int(df.loc[df.year==2025,"pedestrians_killed"].iloc[0]) - int(df.loc[df.year==2013,"pedestrians_killed"].iloc[0]))
print("2025 vs 2019:", int(df.loc[df.year==2025,"pedestrians_killed"].iloc[0]) - int(df.loc[df.year==2019,"pedestrians_killed"].iloc[0]))
EOF
python3 /tmp/analysis.py

Yearly totals were 176, 133, 133, 149, 127, 123, 131, 101, 132, 135, 107, 124, 119 for 2013 through 2025 (total 1,690; average ~130/year). The low was 101 in 2020; since 2020 every year has stayed between 101 and 135, below the 2013 level.
